newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Power details 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Power details 1996 dividend.

text.p: China's Guangdong Electric Power Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday its shareholders have approved the firm's 1996 dividend plans, which include bonus issues and cash payments.

The power supplier will make a two-for-10 bonus issue and award a cash dividend of 0.2 yuan per share for its foreign currency B share holders, a company statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
The B share cash dividend will be converted at a rate of HK$1.0721 to 1.0 yuan, the statement said.
For holders of its domestic currency A shares, the company will make a two-for-10 bonus issue and an after-tax cash payment of 0.182 yuan per share, it said.
The A and B share dividend registration deadlines were set for June 11 and the shares will go ex-dividend the next day, it said.
The bonus A shares will go public on June 16, with the bonus B shares to be listed on June 17, it said.
Guangdong Power posted a net profit of 563.75 million yuan for 1996, compared with 376.97 million yuan based on international accounting standards. (US$1 = 8.3 yuan)
